data.title: 白夜 · 小屋里的热拉面
data.description: 【白夜 · 小屋里的热拉面】忙完一天的白夜换上宽松的旧运动外套和运动短裤，坐在小公寓的餐桌旁吃晚饭。她一手扶着拉面碗，另一手用筷子夹起面条，小心吹散热气，眼前这顿便宜却热乎的晚餐让她安心下来——「趁热吃吧，今天的汤还挺好喝的。」
data.action: 坐在餐桌前，一手扶碗，另一手用筷子夹起面条并轻轻吹凉
data.promptProse: Seated across the dining table, she steadies the ramen bowl with one hand, lifting noodles with chopsticks in the other and blowing away steam. Pendant light warms the bowl against the narrow kitchen.
data.camera: medium shot across the dining table, face, bowl and hands in frame
data.lighting: 小厨房吊灯照亮面碗热气的暖光
data.animaCaption: One hand steadies the bowl while chopsticks lift the noodles in the other.
